fields.finding: The 2017 paper's labelled effective bend volume equals the 360 mm3 span prism. The normalized stress-power integral at m=8.6 instead gives 1.953125 mm3. Ring values likewise need stress-field interpretation.
fields.needed: Reconcile the paper's geometric definitions and size-transfer convention with its full stress field and flaw populations before transferring its fitted data.
fields.effect: Our explicitly defined three-point projection is retained; ring geometric sizes are not used as uniform tensile reference volumes.

claim: The 2017 paper's labelled effective bend volume equals the 360 mm3 span prism. The normalized stress-power integral at m=8.6 instead gives 1.953125 mm3. Ring values likewise need stress-field interpretation.
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: The common equations do not qualify the bond, core law, coatings or installed safety factor. Carry the exact conventions, not an interchangeable headline. [052 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:3a70e117fbb14e85), [CHECK053](unpublished-local-ref:599d3a276c2fcbce).
